policy.scheme: IOB2 labels retained from metadata; no relabeling at chunk boundaries.
policy.supervision: First subword of each original word only; continuation/special/padding labels are -100.
policy.chunking: Greedy nonoverlapping complete-word chunks based only on tokenized word lengths; never gold entities.
policy.oversized_word: Raise an error if one word exceeds the content budget or produces no subword; never silently discard it.
policy.evaluation: Reassemble each original sentence in word order before entity metrics; do not score chunks separately.
policy.context_limit: Whole-word chunking can cut through an entity and limits cross-chunk context; original gold labels are preserved.
policy.padding: Dynamic right-padding per batch; strip alignment metadata before passing a batch to a model.
policy.model_work: Tokenizer preparation only: no model weights, training, predictions or F1 scoring.

source.reason: Development document permits Parquet fallback; datasets 4.0 removes loading scripts.
source.preprocessing: None: no shuffle, split, filtering, label conversion or token normalization.
source.parity_scope: Split sizes, metadata, all-row structure/IOB2 and ordered content hashes checked. Byte-for-byte equivalence to eriktks/conll2003 has not been established.
